snippet.title: Can you Escape Fate?-Escape the Room Game [OFFICIAL TRAILER]
snippet.description:
Download on Apple App Store now! https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/can-you-escape-fate-escape/id1202426899?mt=8
Download on Google Play now! https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.com.jcsoft.canyouescapefate

When your brother mysteriously goes missing in 2016, it’s your job to go back and find him, no matter what the cost. Explore a land devoid of life and stuck in the past with lingering New Years Resolutions to uncover the truth behind the world and yourself.  Avoid blood-thirsty claw machines, failed lab experiments, greedy spirits, and befriend insane yandere souls in exhilarating bullet hell boss battles using an intuitive touch drag control!

Can you Escape Fate : A Zodiac Story is the long awaited sequel to Can You Escape Love, the unique point and click, escape the room survival game unlike any other, from the creators of Animatronic Jumpscare Factory and Five Tries At Love!

Can You Escape Fate is a unique and fresh take on the bullet hell and escape the room genre, merging them together into an unforgettable experience that will take you under the tale of two siblings and the New Year.   Armed with only your own heart and SOUL, survive the unmerciful and cruel world of 2016.  You are the only one who can change your life.  How far will you go to change your fate? Can you escape? 


FEATURES
16+ battles, all unique and feature 50+ different attacks. Innovative Bullet hell gameplay never seen before! 
13 enemies to defeat or befriend
An all new arcade mode where you can fight all the bosses head on
6 Worlds to explore and episodes to unlock! Escape the Room style.
Many secrets and mysteries to solve! 
6 Different Endings to find!
CHALLENGE your friends to fight for the number one spot on the leaderboards! See how you stack up against the world! 

Experience an immersive storyline that will take you through a roller coaster of emotions and action adventure surrounding a world past its time. Interact with your environment to discover the truth under the tale of your own past. Set time back in motion and resume the Zodiac Cycle by fighting your way to the New Year! 

Note: Look forward to new characters and more endings in future updates!
